$comment: The house base (slice 2c of docs/features/directed-performance.md): every value that shapes it, so the base is re-made by `house-base.ts`, never edited by hand. The look follows the owner's pick, soft clay (2026-11-18), from Astra's `clay-turnaround.png`, `base-finishes.png` and `clay-traits.png`; colours are linear, converted from sRGB read off the sheets' lit midtones (`sheetSRGB`). What the build cannot match is in the brief's 2c evidence.
name: house-base

proportions.$comment: Scales about a pivot, weighted by the MPFB mixamo weights of the bones named, so the rig is fitted to the scaled mesh and no bone is ever scaled. head: about the neck joint; hands: about the wrist.

face.$comment: The stylised face (decided by the agent on 2026-11-18, the owner away, for the owner to review; decision 7 of docs/features/directed-performance.md), drawn from the clay sheets: lengths in metres, angles in degrees unless named.

skinUnits.$comment: The faceunits01 units kept on the skin, with their gains; every other face shape is authored on the parts below.

jawMask.$comment: The jaw units fade out from `from` below the mouth up to `to` below it, so they move the chin and leave the mouth to the mouth's own shapes.

smooth.$comment: The front of the face as a depth map on a grid (m): holes narrower than `holes` filled, bumps narrower than `bumps` taken off, blurred by sigma; applied in an ellipse about the eyes' midline, `centre` below eye height, fading out from `fade` of it. A vertex within `tolerance` of the front surface goes onto the smoothed one, one further behind keeps its depth less that. Only head vertices in front of y frontOf move.

eyes.$comment: Each eye's centre `x` from the midline at eye height, its radius, its centre `depth` eye radii behind the smoothed skin; the iris and pupil as angles (radians) from the forward pole.

lids.$comment: Shells about each eye (radius in eye radii) from the edge angle (up from straight ahead) to the back angle; the upper lid's rows within `lash` degrees of its edge are the dark lash line. shapes: the edge angles [upper, lower] each shape moves to (null: that lid stays). A shape's targets go out along their radius as far as needed for every vertex's straight path to stay `clear` eye radii from the centre.

brows.$comment: In eye radii from the eye centre: x from the inner to the outer end, the lower edge at the inner end, its rise toward the outer end, the arch, the thickness (tapering toward the outer end); lift (m) in front of the skin; segments along and rows across.

browShapes.$comment: Moves (m) in the face's plane, then back onto the skin: browDown lowers the inner end by downInner and the outer by downOuter and draws it in by downIn; browInnerUp raises the inner end and draws it out; browOuterUp raises the outer end.

nose.$comment: An ellipsoid (radii, m) `at` of the way from the eyes down to the mouth, `out` of it in front of the skin; noseSneer lifts it.

mouth.$comment: A dark shape on the skin, halfWidth across, thick at the middle (the corners keep `corner` of it), lift in front of the skin, `raise` above the mouth corners the faceunits find.

mouthShapes.$comment: Moves (m) of the mouth's edges in the face's plane. smile: the corners up and out, the middle open, the teeth row dropping `teeth` of the way; roll: corners in, the rolled lip thinner.

sheetSRGB.$comment: sRGB read off clay-turnaround.png's front view (lit midtones); `colours` is these in linear.
